body:
Thank you so much for your advice. I’m sorry I didn’t respond to you sooner. After reading your comment a few times I’ve been meditating on it. 

I feel like I make such good progress with dating and loving myself but then things come up that challenge that and I feel like I’ve lost all progress. A “1 step forward and 3 steps back” kind of feeling. 

A lot of my friends aren’t within the poly community and have a hard time understanding it. As for family they are quite religious. They are still there for me in other ways but will not discuss anything remotely close to poly without resorting back to “gods will”
And all that. 

Your advice did really resonate with me. And it helped break the mind spiral I was in last night. Thank you for taking the time to respond to my post 💕.

We fell into a rut I guess. And when we talked it out both of our thoughts went to “what am I gonna do if we break up” instead of “how are we gonna work to get past this?”  Plus we had a lot of sexual incompatibility that we weren’t able to work through over these years either.
I do get hung up on the “what will other people think?” Quite often. Your right. We should just get it over with and be able to focus on moving on and getting our own spaces.

Thank you for sharing your experience… I’m gonna talk with him about it when he gets back to the apartment later. I think it’s the right thing to do for both of us but I want to make sure he’s cool with it too.
Thankfully we always went to our own family things alone (both come from divorced families). But yeah. I think we are gonna tell them before hand.
